details:
I like that creators can sort avatars into favourite blocks with VRC+, but... 
That requires money. Also, the favourite groups are still at the bottom. It makes sense for them to be there. I'd like to reiterate the request to be able to sort created avatars into favourites by having a special "priority avatar list" of the four you may use most. Just to be at the top, so it's there, noticable, and easily accessible. I run into issues finding the avatars I use most often because I've now started to upload so many it gets physically difficult keeping track of them, and the current method of VRC+ handling them just does not work for me.
Is it possible to have a small priority list, separate from favourites, ONLY for things you made? Better yet, if the priority list is ONLY VISIBLE WHEN YOU ADD THINGS TO IT, it would make it more accessible and easier to use for people who may use it. This is sort of a personal request but I think it'd be useful and helpful to people who make a lot.
title: Small Priority Avatar list
